source.limitations: Transcribed from the Williams County Health Department Septage Haulers PDF (Haulers-2026-1.pdf; printed footer 02/19/2026; Page 1 prints 8 TOTAL), linked as Haulers/Pumpers from the Household Sewage Treatment Systems page (https://www.williamscountyhealth.org/environmental-health/septic-2/). Publisher block on the PDF: 310 LINCOLN AVE, MONTPELIER, OH 43543, Phone 1-419-485-3141, Fax 1-419-485-5420. The official file is a one-page scan (LANIER MP C3004, CreationDate 2026-02-19 18:41:03 UTC, page rotation 270, no text layer). The archived .txt is a visual transcription of the printed page. Spellings kept as printed, including AUTOMATIC SEPTIC & WELL, CO. with the comma and CO., FISCHER PLUMBING & HEATING INC with no period after INC and operator FISCHER PLUMBING AND HEATING, LAYMAN SEPTIC TANK & DRAIN CLEANING LLC address 18-408 CTY RD 20 with the hyphen, PRECISION WELL AND SEPTIC, LLC with AND and the comma before LLC, UNITED RENTALS (NORTH AMERICA) INC with no comma or period after INC and operator line DBA: RELIABLE ONSITE SERVICES, and TRESSLER PLUMBING LLC address BOX 433. Street and city lines are joined with a space as printed. No local registration numbers on this PDF. Phones are shown as printed. ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). The Installers PDF and the Service Provider PDF on the parent page were not transcribed and were not merged. The ODH statewide septage-hauler bond list was not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with the Williams County Health Department and ODH before you hire.
